prompts.idle: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: authored 2D game sprite animation sheet. Image identity: cute orange CAN HERMIT CRAB beneath a crushed red/white drinks-can shell with warm metal scuffs, golden cone spikes and big silver pull-tab/opening at TOP SCREEN-RIGHT. Two small glossy dark oval eyes (no extra eye stalks), toothed orange mandibles, TWO large orange/red front pincers and SIX orange jointed walking legs behind them (natural occlusion allowed). Preserve exact shell opening/spike/pulltab arrangement, red/white marks, larger near claw and original front three-quarter camera, warm painterly highlights and dark clean outline. No written labels. EXACTLY FOUR complete crab+shell drawings in strict equal TWO rows TWO columns, each centered same size and camera, entire pulltab/spikes/claws/legs fit within at most50%cell width/height, generous EMPTY transparent center gutters/margins. Real transparent alpha. No backdrop/ground shadow/haze/text/grid/arrows/sparks/extra crab or limbs; no detached metal parts. Do NOT mirror the shell/face/claws. Genuine articulated leg/claw/eye changes, never resized copies of a still image. Four planted idle/blink poses:1 relaxed legs and front pincers slightly open, eyes open;2 tiny claw and mandible settling, eyes open;3 BOTH eyes halfway covered by orange lids with dark pupils inside their outlines;4 BOTH eyes FULLY CLOSED as short dark curved lines, no oval pupil or highlight visible. Keep shell mass and planted contacts unchanged.
